name: Craft an Iron Axe
rationale: Craft an Iron Axe to chop wood more efficiently and use it as a weapon. Shows the COMPLETE tool chain from scratch including wooden and stone pickaxe prerequisites.
actual: Use a Crafting Table to combine 3 Iron Ingots and 2 Sticks in the correct pattern to make an Iron Axe. Requires full tool chain: wooden pickaxe → stone pickaxe → mine iron → smelt → craft.

plan.goal: Collect logs and craft basic tools
plan.action_nl: Collect oak logs, craft planks, sticks, crafting table, and a wooden pickaxe.
plan.notes: Axes need 3 iron ingots + 2 sticks. Collect extra logs for sticks and crafting table.

plan.goal: Mine cobblestone and craft stone pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Use the wooden pickaxe to mine cobblestone, then craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Stone pickaxe is REQUIRED to mine iron ore. Wooden pickaxe cannot harvest iron.

plan.action_nl: Find and mine iron ore underground using the stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Mining iron_ore drops raw_iron in Minecraft 1.17+. Stone pickaxe or better required.

plan.goal: Smelt raw iron into iron ingots
plan.action_nl: Use a furnace to smelt raw iron into iron ingots.
plan.notes: Use raw_iron not iron_ore for smelting.

plan.action_nl: Use a Crafting Table to combine 3 iron ingots and 2 sticks in an 'L' shape.
plan.expected: An Iron Axe is added to your inventory.
plan.notes: Iron axe deals more damage than stone axe and chops wood faster.

name: Craft a Diamond Pickaxe
rationale: Craft a Diamond Pickaxe to mine obsidian and other rare materials efficiently. Shows the complete tool chain from wood to diamond tier.
actual: Use a Crafting Table to combine 3 Diamonds and 2 Sticks to make a Diamond Pickaxe. Requires full tool chain: wooden pickaxe → stone pickaxe → iron pickaxe → mine diamonds → craft.

plan.goal: Collect logs and craft basic tools

plan.action_nl: Use wooden pickaxe to mine cobblestone, then craft a stone pickaxe.
plan.notes: Stone pickaxe is needed to mine iron ore.

plan.goal: Mine iron, smelt, and craft iron pickaxe
plan.action_nl: Mine 3 iron ore with stone pickaxe, smelt raw_iron into ingots, craft an iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Iron pickaxe is the minimum tool required to mine diamond ore. Mining iron_ore drops raw_iron in 1.17+.

plan.action_nl: Find and mine 3 diamond ore blocks deep underground (below Y=-58) using the iron pickaxe.
plan.notes: Diamonds only spawn below Y=-58. You MUST use an iron pickaxe or better.

plan.action_nl: Use a Crafting Table to combine 3 diamonds and 2 sticks in a 'T' shape pattern.
plan.expected: A Diamond Pickaxe is added to your inventory.
plan.notes: Diamond Pickaxe can mine obsidian and is the fastest pickaxe tier before netherite.

plan.expected: Wooden pickaxe and crafting table in inventory.
plan.notes: 3 logs → 12 planks: 4 for crafting_table, 2 for sticks, 3 for wooden_pickaxe, 3 spare. wooden_pickaxe is required to mine stone; crafting_table is required for 3×3 recipes (pickaxe + furnace).

plan.action_nl: Mine 11 stone blocks with the wooden pickaxe: 8 for the furnace recipe, 3 as smelt input.
plan.notes: Mining stone without Silk Touch always yields cobblestone. Collect enough for both the furnace (8) and the smelt input (3).

plan.action_nl: Craft a furnace using 8 cobblestone (3×3 ring pattern) at the crafting table.
plan.notes: Furnace recipe: 8 cobblestone in a ring on a 3×3 crafting grid. Requires crafting_table.

plan.action_nl: Use the furnace to smelt 3 cobblestone into smooth stone (use spare planks as fuel).
plan.notes: smeltItem places the furnace automatically if one is nearby or in inventory. Spare oak_planks from step 1 serve as fuel.

plan.action_nl: Arrange 3 smooth stone in a horizontal row to craft 6 stone slabs.
plan.notes: stone_slab requires smooth stone (not cobblestone). Recipe yields 6 slabs from 3 stone in a horizontal row.

name: Craft a Bow
rationale: Craft a Bow for ranged combat. Requires 3 sticks + 3 string. String is obtained by killing spiders, not crafting — demonstrates combat resource acquisition.
actual: Craft planks→sticks, hunt spiders for string (3 needed), then combine sticks and string to craft a bow.

plan.action_nl: Collect oak logs and craft enough sticks for the bow (3 needed).
plan.notes: Bow needs exactly 3 sticks and 3 string. Craft extra sticks for safety.

plan.action_nl: Find and kill spiders to collect 3 string. Spiders drop 0-2 string each — kill 2-3 spiders. Spiders spawn at night or in dark areas.
plan.notes: String CANNOT be crafted — it only drops from spiders. Each spider drops 0-2 string. Kill 2-3 spiders to be safe. Having a sword speeds this up.

plan.action_nl: Combine 3 sticks and 3 string in a specific diagonal pattern to craft a bow.
plan.expected: A Bow is added to your inventory.
plan.notes: Bow requires 3 sticks (right column) + 3 string (left diagonal). Used with arrows for ranged attacks.
